scripts.start: node -e "const {spawnSync}=require('child_process');const isCI=/^(1|true)$/i.test(String(process.env.CI||''));const npmCmd=process.platform==='win32'?'npm.cmd':'npm';if(isCI){console.log('[recipe_frontend] CI detected: redirecting to start:serve to avoid watch server (exit 137).');const r=spawnSync(npmCmd,['run','start:serve'],{stdio:'inherit'});process.exit(r.status??0);}const r=spawnSync(npmCmd,['run','_start:dev'],{stdio:'inherit'});process.exit(r.status??0);"

scripts.start:serve: cross-env REACT_APP_ENABLE_SOURCE_MAPS=false node -e "const p=process.env.REACT_APP_PORT||process.env.PORT||3000;const host=process.env.HOST||'0.0.0.0';process.env.REACT_APP_PORT=p;process.env.PORT=p;process.env.HOST=host;process.env.NODE_OPTIONS='--max-old-space-size=256';const {spawnSync,spawn}=require('child_process');const npmCmd=process.platform==='win32'?'npm.cmd':'npm';const npxCmd=process.platform==='win32'?'npx.cmd':'npx';const r=spawnSync(npmCmd,['run','build:ci'],{stdio:'inherit'});if((r.status||0)!==0)process.exit(r.status||1);const child=spawn(npxCmd,['serve','-s','build','-L','-n','-C','--single','-l',`${host}:${p}`],{stdio:'inherit'});child.on('spawn',()=>{setTimeout(()=>{try{const hr=spawnSync(npmCmd,['run','healthcheck'],{stdio:'inherit'});if((hr.status||0)!==0)console.warn('[recipe_frontend] healthcheck failed but continuing to serve.');}catch(e){}},1500);});child.on('exit',(code)=>process.exit(code||0));"
scripts.healthcheck: node -e "const http=require('http');const port=process.env.REACT_APP_PORT||process.env.PORT||3000;const hcPath=(process.env.REACT_APP_HEALTHCHECK_PATH)||'/health.html';const idxPath='/';const host='127.0.0.1';function check(path){return new Promise((resolve)=>{const opts={host,port,path,timeout:5000};const req=http.get(opts,res=>{let data='';res.on('data',c=>data+=c);res.on('end',()=>{const okMeta=/(<meta[^>]*name=[\"\']x-healthcheck[\"\'][^>]*content=[\"\']ok[\"\'][^>]*>)/i.test(data);const statusOk=res.statusCode===200;console.log(`[healthcheck] url=http://${host}:${port}${path} status=${res.statusCode} meta=${okMeta?'ok':'missing'}`);resolve(statusOk&&okMeta);});});req.on('timeout',()=>{console.error('[healthcheck] timeout');req.destroy();resolve(false)});req.on('error',e=>{console.error('[healthcheck] error:',e.message);resolve(false)});});} (async()=>{if(await check(hcPath))process.exit(0);if(await check(idxPath))process.exit(0);process.exit(1)})();"
scripts.prestart: echo "INFO: In CI, 'npm run start:serve' is preferred to avoid exit code 137 (watch server). 'npm start' auto-redirects when CI=true."
